key_findings: ACC LAMB1 is downregulated after peripheral neuropathy; its knockdown exacerbates pain sensitivity and induces anxiety/depression-like behaviors.
LAMB1 loss acts via integrin β1 and Src-dependent RhoA/LIMK/cofilin signaling, altering presynaptic release and spine remodeling.
